techhoman.caption:
There is no cheap GPU anymore. The entry-level tier quietly moved two rungs up the ladder and nobody sent a memo.

Nvidia's RTX 5060 launched at a $299.99 MSRP. Tom's Hardware put the median of Newegg listings at $469.99 on 10 August 2026 — $170 above launch.

Drop your budget below and I'll spec the build at the prices that actually exist today.

#pcbuild #gamingpc #pcparts #buildapc #techhoman

The advice was always build it yourself, it's cheaper. Not this month.

Tom's Guide (Jason England, 5 Dec 2025) took an $829 prebuilt gaming desktop and matched the components on PCPartPicker. Total before even adding a power supply or a case: $895.07.

Drop your budget below and I'll tell you whether a build or a prebuilt gets you more.

#pcbuild #gamingpc #pcparts #buildapc #techhoman

Everyone is holding out for the dip. The top of the stack has never dipped once.

The RTX 5090 went from $1,999 to $4,288 — a $2,289 increase, 114.5% — and Tom's Hardware says its price has only ever increased, never dropping below launch. Figures as of 3 August 2026.

Comment BUILD and I'll send you a part list priced to the market that exists, not the one you remember.

#pcbuild #gamingpc #pcparts #buildapc #techhoman

Same parts. Two prices. The box wins.

Tom's Guide (Jason England, 5 Dec 2025): a Skytech with a Ryzen 7 7700, RTX 5060 Ti 16GB, 32GB DDR5 and a 1TB SSD at $1,299, while the closest match he could put together on PCPartPicker came to $1,455.63 — a $156.63 gap.

Drop your budget below before you order a single part.

#pcbuild #gamingpc #pcparts #buildapc #techhoman

Nvidia brought back a 2021 card in late June 2026 so gamers had a cheap option. It stopped being cheap almost immediately.

MSI's Ventus 2X OC RTX 3060 12GB launched at $300 on MSI's store and now lists at $480 — a 60% increase in less than two months. Tom's Hardware, 27 August 2026.

Comment BUILD and I'll price your part list against what it costs today.

#pcbuild #gamingpc #pcparts #buildapc #techhoman

The budget build moved and nobody told you.

BGR (Eduardo Ariedo, 8 Mar 2026): a solid gaming build that once came in under $1,000 now pushes closer to $1,250, and that's before an operating system license. DDR5, DDR4, GPUs and SSDs have all followed the same path.

Comment BUILD and I'll spec one to the budget you actually have.

#pcbuild #gamingpc #pcparts #buildapc #techhoman

People blame the GPU. Then they look at the memory line and go quiet.

A mainstream 64GB (2x32GB) DDR5-5600 kit that cost under $200 last summer now demands over $1,100 — roughly five times, in twelve months. Tom's Hardware, 17 August 2026.

Drop your budget below and I'll cut the capacity you don't need out of the list.

#pcbuild #gamingpc #pcparts #buildapc #techhoman

A whole price tier just disappeared.

Tom's Hardware's build guide (Joe Shields and Avram Piltch, page updated 3 Aug 2026) dropped the $500 tier because $500 won't cut it at today's prices. Entry is now $800, and their $4,000+ dream build ended up over $6,000.

Drop your budget below and I'll show what it buys today.

#pcbuild #gamingpc #pcparts #buildapc #techhoman

The advice going around is to fall back to an older DDR4 platform. It is still cheaper — it is just not the escape hatch people think it is.

DDR4 kits are up anywhere from 120% to nearly 180% across the board, with one kit going from $105 last year to $281 this year. Tom's Hardware, 17 August 2026, which also notes DDR4 pricing is nowhere near as bad as DDR5.

Comment BUILD and I'll price the DDR4 and DDR5 versions of your build side by side.

#pcbuild #gamingpc #pcparts #buildapc #techhoman

This is a mainstream card, not a halo card.

Tom's Hardware's GPU price tracker (Stewart Bendle, table updated 14 Sep 2026): RTX 5060 Ti 16GB at a best US price of $779, against a $429 launch MSRP and a $379 lowest-ever US price. The 8GB variants are still going near MSRP.

Comment BUILD and I'll spec around what GPUs actually cost right now.

#pcbuild #gamingpc #pcparts #buildapc #techhoman

Memory took the headlines. Storage quietly did the same thing.

Tom's Hardware's live SSD tracker lists the Samsung 990 Pro 1TB at a $239 best US price against a $59 lowest-ever US price — more than four times. Page updated 10 September 2026.

Comment BUILD and I'll pick the storage tier that doesn't eat the rest of the budget.

#pcbuild #gamingpc #pcparts #buildapc #techhoman

The scam isn't the price. It's the box.

Tom's Hardware (Kunal Khullar, 22 Aug 2026) on an alleged Amazon delivery scam: a New York PC shop says it ordered a Ryzen 5 9600X and received only the retail box, requested a refund, reordered with next-day delivery, and received a second empty box.

Comment BUILD if you want your parts list sourced for you.

#pcbuild #gamingpc #pcparts #buildapc #techhoman

This isn't only a DDR5 problem. The pressure has pushed buyers so far down the stack that DDR2 is now in short supply.

TrendForce estimates DDR2 contract prices will rise roughly 55-60% in 2Q26 with a further 35-40% in 3Q26, as some OEMs replace DDR4 designs with DDR3 and redesign certain DDR3 products to use DDR2. TrendForce, 22 June 2026.

Comment BUILD and I'll spec your build around the tiers that got hit hardest.

#pcbuild #gamingpc #pcparts #buildapc #techhoman

Retail is bad. Resale is worse.

Tom's Hardware (Zhiye Liu, 11 Dec 2025): scalpers reselling DDR5 memory kits on eBay at up to twice the retail price, with some kits going above $2,000 and gouged kits fetching seven times their original value.

Comment BUILD and I'll price the kit your board actually takes.

#pcbuild #gamingpc #pcparts #buildapc #techhoman

Everyone is furious at the graphics card. The receipts point somewhere else entirely.

TechSpot found DDR5 has more than quadrupled over the past eight months, while GPUs sat just 16% above their true MSRP metric on average across the 10 regions they track — 10% excluding the RTX 5090. TechSpot, 31 July 2026.

Drop your budget below and I'll show you exactly where your money is going.

#pcbuild #gamingpc #pcparts #buildapc #techhoman

"Wait for prices to drop" has a cost, and the man saying so sells SSDs.

Tom's Hardware (Jowi Morales, 16 Dec 2025) quoting Kingston's Cameron Crandall: NAND prices up 246% from 1Q25, with 70% of that in the last 60 days, and NAND making up 90% of the bill of materials for an SSD.

Comment BUILD and I'll size storage to your budget.

#pcbuild #gamingpc #pcparts #buildapc #techhoman

AI demand is real. It is also a very convenient thing for a board partner to point at.

Jon Peddie Research point-of-sale tracking shows AIB sales going from $6.18 billion in Q1 2025 to $10.85 billion in Q1 2026 — a 76% increase on 28% more units — and Peddie suggests makers are hiking beyond the actual memory cost increase. Tom's Hardware, 17 August 2026.

Comment BUILD and I'll send you the shortlist of cards worth paying for.

#pcbuild #gamingpc #pcparts #buildapc #techhoman

The card isn't the only thing you're buying.

Nvidia's own RTX 5090 product specifications (accessed 23 Sep 2026): 575W total graphics power, 1000W required system power.

Drop your budget below and I'll include the power supply in the spec.

#pcbuild #gamingpc #pcparts #buildapc #techhoman

A budget CPU that launches above its own budget price tells you where this is heading.

On Amazon the Ryzen 5 5500F is $120 and the Ryzen 5 7500 is $210 — both $20 more than AMD's suggested retail pricing, from first-party sellers. Tom's Hardware, 21 September 2026.

Drop your budget below and I'll build to the number you actually have.

#pcbuild #gamingpc #pcparts #buildapc #techhoman

The build cost is the number people quote. The run cost isn't.

U.S. Energy Information Administration, Electric Power Monthly Table 5.3: residential electricity averaged 18.34 cents per kilowatt-hour in June 2026.

Watts x hours / 1000 = kWh. kWh x $0.1834 = what it actually costs you.

Comment BUILD and I'll spec for the wattage you want to live with.

#pcbuild #gamingpc #pcparts #buildapc #techhoman

realmsystems.caption:
Someone looks you up, finds no site, and that is the end of it.

Clutch, 21 August 2025: 83% of small businesses now have a website, 17% remain offline.

Comment SITE and we'll talk about your page.

#smallbusiness #localbusiness #websitedesign #smallbusinessowner #realmsystems

Slow sites don't announce themselves. People just leave, and you never see them.

Google's neural-net analysis of real bounce data found that as mobile page load goes from 1 second to 10 seconds, the probability of a mobile visitor bouncing increases 123%. Think with Google, Daniel An, 20 February 2018.

Comment SITE and we'll time your page and send you the number.

#smallbusiness #localbusiness #websitedesign #smallbusinessowner #realmsystems

Your reviews are good. But when someone reads them and goes looking for your website, there is nothing there.

BrightLocal's Local Consumer Review Survey of 1,002 US adults, published 11 Feb 2026: after reading positive reviews, 54% of consumers then check the business's website.

One page gives them somewhere to land: what you do, where you work, how to reach you. Comment SITE and we'll build yours.

#smallbusiness #localbusiness #websitedesign #smallbusinessowner #realmsystems

It is not your trade that decides whether you have a website. It is your size.

Eurostat, 2025 reference year: 95.65% of large EU enterprises have a website, against 76.66% of small ones. A nineteen point gap.

This is EU data, so it describes European firms, not every market. Comment SITE and we'll start yours.

#smallbusiness #localbusiness #websitedesign #smallbusinessowner #realmsystems

If you've never measured your load time, it just feels fine — on your own phone, on your own wifi.

A Deloitte study commissioned by Google found a 0.1-second mobile speed improvement lifted retail conversions by 8.4%. That's retail e-commerce, not a local trade — take the direction, not the number. Deloitte Ireland, "Milliseconds Make Millions", 24 March 2020.

Comment SITE and we'll tell you where your tenths are going.

#smallbusiness #localbusiness #websitedesign #smallbusinessowner #realmsystems

Losing jobs to the company down the road and not sure why? Look at what homeowners said they expect before they hire.

Housecall Pro, published 10 Dec 2025 (1,040 US homeowners, surveyed 23 Oct 2025): across generations, 96% expect a user-friendly, professional website.

No site means no way to meet that. One clean page covers it: your work, your area, your number. Comment SITE and we'll build yours.

#smallbusiness #localbusiness #websitedesign #smallbusinessowner #realmsystems

Five stars on the listing, nothing when they look you up, and they go elsewhere.

DreamHost Local Business Trust Index, 1,201 US consumers surveyed November 2025: 39% have declined to visit or buy from a business specifically because it lacked a website.

One page — what you do, your area, your number — gives them somewhere to land. Comment SITE if you want it.

#smallbusiness #localbusiness #websitedesign #smallbusinessowner #realmsystems

There's no mystery about how fast is fast enough. Google publishes the bar.

Largest Contentful Paint should be 2.5 seconds or less, measured at the 75th percentile of page loads, segmented across mobile and desktop. web.dev (Google), last updated 4 September 2025.

Comment SITE and we'll run yours cold, on a real phone, on mobile data.

#smallbusiness #localbusiness #websitedesign #smallbusinessowner #realmsystems

No calls coming in? Start with where the search happens.

BrightLocal asked 1,227 US consumers about their latest local business search (published 9 Jul 2026): for 73% of respondents, it started on mobile.

One page, built for phones, gives people who look you up somewhere to land, with your number one tap away. Comment SITE and we'll build yours.

#smallbusiness #localbusiness #websitedesign #smallbusinessowner #realmsystems

To someone who has never met you, you are a phone number and nothing else.

DreamHost Local Business Trust Index, 1,201 US consumers surveyed November 2025: 45% say businesses without websites feel less 'real', and businesses with one are perceived as 41% more trustworthy.

Comment SITE for one page that shows you're real.

#smallbusiness #localbusiness #websitedesign #smallbusinessowner #realmsystems

A website will not move you up Google Maps. Nobody can honestly promise that. What it does is catch the people who already found you.

Across 45,264 local businesses, the average Google listing produced 33 website clicks a month out of 59 total actions — the commonest of the three actions. BrightLocal, Google My Business Insights Study, 15 July 2019.

Comment SITE if that click is currently going nowhere.

#smallbusiness #localbusiness #websitedesign #smallbusinessowner #realmsystems

You see the missed call at six. Most of them had decided long before that.

BrightLocal, 1,227 US consumers, 24 June 2026: 75% take less than 30 minutes to decide which business to use, and 28% decide in under five.

That study measures how fast people choose, not what a late callback costs you. But a page answers while you're on the job. Comment SITE if you want one.

#smallbusiness #localbusiness #websitedesign #smallbusinessowner #realmsystems

Reviews are the one thing you can influence for free.

A Harvard Business School study matched Yelp ratings against Washington State restaurant tax records and found a one-star increase led to a 5-9% increase in revenue — an effect driven by independent restaurants, with no effect on chains. Michael Luca, HBS Working Paper 12-016, September 2011, revised March 2016.

That's restaurants on Yelp, not your trade on Google. It's still the cleanest measurement anyone has put on a star.

Comment SITE and we'll put the review link on your site.

#smallbusiness #localbusiness #websitedesign #smallbusinessowner #realmsystems

People do not work down a long list. They glance at a few and choose.

BrightLocal, 1,227 US consumers, 24 June 2026: 72% look at three or fewer businesses before deciding, and only 1% look at more than ten.

No one can promise you a place in that first three. A page just means the people who do find you have somewhere to land. Comment SITE if you want one.

#smallbusiness #localbusiness #websitedesign #smallbusinessowner #realmsystems

Owners ask how many reviews they need. The number doesn't matter if the link never goes out.

96% of consumers are open to writing your business a review. BrightLocal Local Consumer Review Survey 2025, a representative panel of 1,026 US adults, published 29 January 2025.

Comment SITE and we'll put the link where they'll actually press it.

#smallbusiness #localbusiness #websitedesign #smallbusinessowner #realmsystems

No hours, no services, one photo from 2019, and the website box empty.

Google Business Profile Help, accessed 23 September 2026: customers are 2.7 times more likely to consider a business reputable, and 70% more likely to visit, when it has a complete Business Profile. That is Google's own wording, not mine — and Google publishes no method behind those numbers.

Filling in your profile is free and you should just do it. The one box on it we can fill for you is the website. Comment SITE if yours is blank.

#smallbusiness #localbusiness #websitedesign #smallbusinessowner #realmsystems

Phone-only booking works right up until you're under a van, on a ladder, or already with a customer.

94% of respondents said they'd be more likely to choose a new service provider if that provider offered online booking options. GetApp, 217 US respondents screened from 412 surveyed, March 2021, published 7 April 2021.

Comment SITE and we'll wire a form to your calendar.

#smallbusiness #localbusiness #websitedesign #smallbusinessowner #realmsystems

Hardly anyone types your business name. They type the job they need doing.

BrightLocal Google My Business Insights Study, 45,000 listings across 36 industries, September 2017 to December 2018: the average business was found in 1,009 searches per month, 84% of them discovery searches — someone searching a category, product or service rather than a business name.

That data is from 2018 and Google has changed plenty since. Comment SITE if you want a page those searches can land on.

#smallbusiness #localbusiness #websitedesign #smallbusinessowner #realmsystems

The calls you never hear about are the ones that came in at 7pm.

14.1% of inbound calls to residential HVAC shops arrived outside business hours in June 2025, against 9.8% in October, the year's low. ServiceTitan, State of the Trades, 3 June 2026. Business hours are Mon-Fri, 8am-5pm local time.

That counts when calls arrived, not whether anyone answered them. Yours is the part you already know.

Comment SITE and we'll add a form for the 7pm caller.

#smallbusiness #localbusiness #websitedesign #smallbusinessowner #realmsystems

Every trade has a dead season. The work moves, it doesn't disappear.

"AC repair" searches run 266% above their February low at the July peak, while "furnace repair" runs 137% above its May low at the January peak. WebFX, Ahrefs Keywords Explorer data for January 2023 - December 2024, published 12 December 2025.

Comment SITE and we'll build you a page for both seasons.

#smallbusiness #localbusiness #websitedesign #smallbusinessowner #realmsystems
